sources.responsibility: Fail-closed detection of pulse, host-expression, and unknown time-dependent drives.
Determines whether accepted endpoint RHS may be reused as next-step k0.
Separates RK23/RK45 endpoint shortcut eligibility from k0 reuse under frozen spins and PBC.
Hashes plan, Zeeman, Oersted, STT, SOT, DMI, frozen-spin, and GPU state generation.
Enables fsal_method for Heun, RK4, RK23, and RK45 when k0 reuse is allowed.
Validates cached FSAL time/signature and resets predictor last_solved_stage_time_s to current_time.
Gates DP54/BS23 endpoint_valid publication with gpu_rk_allows_endpoint_rhs_shortcut.
Propagates FSAL k0 with timestamp/signature and commits accepted Krylov potential after DuringFinalFieldRefresh.
FP64 CUDA kernel evaluating phi_n + alpha * (phi_n - phi_{n-1}).
Enforces history, equal-stage monotonicity, dt_ratio <= 2.0, and operator-signature guards.
Lazily allocates Krylov-only history buffers and shifts accepted endpoint potentials.
Idempotently frees predictor device buffers and clears metadata.
Inline metadata invalidation usable from host and CUDA paths without freeing buffers.
Applies Krylov-only warm-start prediction, auto-invalidates on non-RK purposes, and advances last_solved_stage_time_s.
Destroys predictor device buffers alongside FemGpuState teardown.
Owns the step transaction journal snapshotting and restoring FSAL and predictor metadata.
Public FEM linear-solver policy governing Krylov convergence and residual certification.
